newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BULGARIA, April 14 - Varna - east - 7 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 8 awaiting orders. West - 7 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load. Bourgas - East - 10 Vessels due, 8 loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 7 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 4 under repair/drydock. West - 4 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth.

April 15 - Bourgas - 18 Vessels operating of which 10 loading, 1 lead/pipes, 4 steel, 1 timber, general, 1 fertiliser, 1 metal, 1 benzene. 5 Discharging, 1 fishmeal, 2 coal, 1 iron ore, 1 petrol. 2 Discharging/loading, 1 salt/coils/zinc, 1 cars/general, 1 empty vessel. 9 Vessels waiting in roads of which 4 to load, 1 jet fuel, 1 metal, 1 fertiliser, 1 tanker. 1 To discharge sugar, 1 to discharge/load heavy parcels/metals. 3 Empty vessels. 13 Vessels due of which 8 to load, 1 sugar/containers, 1 zinc/timber, 1 lead, 1 equipment, 2 steel, 1 metals, 1 bentonite. 4 To discharge, 1 coke, 2 coal, 1 lead concentrate, 1 to discharge/load containers.

Varna - 43 Vessels operating of which 25 loading, 7 fertiliser, 1 tsp, 1 scrap, 6 soda, 1 ntp/soda, 1 kaoline/shamot, 3 quartz sand, 2 clinker, 1 scrap, 1 cigarettes, 1 kaoline. 8 Discharging, 3 phosphorite, 1 wheat, 2 coal, 1 coke, 1 trucks, 1 discharging/loading phosphorite/urea, 2 discharging/loading trucks/containers, 7 discharging/loading containers. 8 Vessels waiting in roads of which 4 to load, 1 tsp, 1 scrap, urea, 1 kaoline, 1 to discharge coke, 3 cargo not nominated.

CROATIA, April 14 - Rasa - Two vessels discharging at berth. Rijeka - Two vessels discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth, 9 under repair/dry-dock, 6 due. Delays expected. Zadar - One vessel discharging at berth, 1 due. Delays expected. 1 Under repair/dry-dock. Split - One vessel loading at berth, 1 under repair/dry-dock. Ploce - One vessel discharging at berth. Dubrovnik - Three vessels awaiting orders. Pula, Sibenik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, April 15 - Limassol - Vessels due on 16/4, 6 containers, 2 conventional, 5 passenger. No delays expected. 4 Container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 1 ro-ro discharging/loading at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge/load. Larnaca - Vessels due on 16/4, 2 container, 1 conventional. 1 Container discharging/loading at berth, 1 conventional vessel discharging.

ESTONIA, April 15 - Tallinn City port - No vessels in port. Kopli - 5 Vessels due, 2 discharging at berth of which 1 meat, 1 sugar/flour. Parnu - 11 Vessels due. No delays expected. Loading at berth, 5 timber, 1 wood granules, 3 peat. Muuga - 6 Vessels due. No delays. Loading at berth, 2 fuel oil, 1 peat, 1 timber, 1 scrap, 1 paper, 2 containers. Discharging at berth, 1 poultry, 2 benzene, 3 grain, 2 container.

ITALY, April 15 - Naples - One gas tanker to berth 15/4 PM Or 16/4 am. Gaeta, Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays. 27 Vessels berthed, 4 in drydock. Multedo oil harbour - No vessels in roads/no delays, 2 berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads/no delays, 3 berthed. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads/no delays, 4 berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 7 berthed, 5 under repair/dry-dock. Leghorn - Five vessels in roads, 36 berthed. Civitavecchia, Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo, Ancona/Falconara, Venice - No vessels in roads, no delays. Augusta oil harbour, Syracuse oil harbour, Ravenna - No delays. Sarroch - Ten vessels in roads, 6 berthed. Taranto - Ten in roads. Trieste - Two in roads. Some congestion at Siot/Tal oil terminal.

LATVIA, April 14 - Riga - 15 Operating of which 5 timber loaders, 1 cotton loader, 2 container loaders, 2 tanker loaders, 2 steel loaders, 3 frozen fish dischargers, 5 waiting. No delays. 21 Due. Ventspils - Four operating of which 2 steel loaders, 1 butter discharger, 1 timber loader. 2 waiting. No delays, 19 due. Liepaja - Seven operating. No delays, 4 due.

LITHUANIA, April 14 - Klaipeda - Vessels loading in port, 1 scrap, 2 fertiliser, 1 metal, 1 rapeseed, 1 steel coils. Discharging, 5 fish, 2 bananas, 1 steel, 1 sugar, 1 fertiliser, 2 fish powder. 2 Vessels loading/discharging, 1 in roads, 29 due.

POLAND, April 15 - Szczecin - 76 Vessels due, 41 loading at berth, 33 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 7 under repair/drydock. Gdynia - 11 Vessels operating of which 5 loading at berth (4 general cargo, 1 coal). 6 Discharging at berth (4 general cargo, 1 grain, 1 coal). 2 Vessels under repair/drydock, 30 due. Gdansk - 14 Vessels operating of which 9 loading at berth (4 bulk, 2 general cargo, 2 coal, 1 tanker). 5 Discharging at berth, 2 bulk, 2 coal, 1 general cargo). 2 Bulkers awaiting turn, 3 vessels under repair/drydock, 18 due.

PORTUGAL, April 14 - Leixoes - Vessels operating, 6 general cargo, 3 container vessels, no vessels awaiting berth. Places vacant, 8 piers with cranes, 2 piers without cranes. April 15 - Lisbon - 37 Vessels due, 94 in port, 5 loading at berth, 25 unloading at berth, 6 loading and unloading berth. 4 Vessels loading at anchorage, 16 under repair/drydock, 5 awaiting orders, 27 miscellaneous craft. Setubal - Vessels in port, 5 loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 8 under repair/drydock. Vessels due, 4 for discharging, 3 for loading, 1 for repair/drydock.

ROMANIA, April 14 - Constantza - 33 Vessels operating of which 15 generals (12 loading, 3 discharging). 11 Bulkers (6 loading, discharging), 1 bagged chemical loading, 1 tanker discharging, 1 cement loading, 4 containers (3 loading, 1 discharging), 2 general cargo waiting in roads for loading. Constantza sud (Agigea) - Nine general cargo (8 loading, 1 discharging). Mangalia - No vessels loading/discharging. Midia - Four vessels loading livestock carriers.

RUSSIA, April 14 - BALTIC PORTS - Kaliningrad - Seven vessels operating, no delays, 6 vessels due. Vyborg - Six vessels due. St. Petersburg - 24 Vessels operating of which loading, 8 non-ferrous, 1 fertiliser, 1 cellulose, 1 coal. Discharging, 1 frozen chicken, 3 containers, 1 rice, 1 frozen meal, 2 vegetables, 3 general cargo, 1 milk powder, 1 fertiliser. 8 Vessels awaiting operations, 7 due.

FAR EAST ports - Vladivostok - 21 Vessels in port of which 2 passenger vessels. 11 Vessels loading (6 metal, 2 timber, 1 soya, 2 containers). 2 Discharging (1 general cargo, 1 sugar), 6 waiting. Nakhodka - 13 Vessels in port of which 7 loading (3 metal, 4 timber), 6 waiting. Vostochniy - 11 Vessels in port of which 5 loading (3 timber, 1 coal, 1 cars). 1 Discharging/loading containers, 5 waiting. Posyet - No vessels in port. Zarubino - No vessels in port. No delays or congestion in ports.

BLACK SEA - Novorossiysk - 22 Vessels operating of which 11 loading, 3 steel, 2 scrap, 1 wheat, 1 non-ferrous metal, 1 seeds, 1 copper concentrate, 1 salt petre, 1 zinc. 11 Discharging, 1 grain, 2 rice, 3 sugar, 2 citrus, 1 bananas, 1 cement, 1 urea. 28 Vessels waiting in roads of which 14 to load, 9 steel, 1 paper, 1 cellulose, 1 fertiliser in bags, 1 tin, 1 aluminium. 14 To discharge, 7 sugar, 4 rice, 2 citrus, 1 cars. 52 Vessels due of which 33 to load, 2 scrap, 1 pig iron, 13 steel, 1 zinc, 1 aluminium, 1 wire, 1 nails/wire, 1 copper, 3 copper cathodes, 1 paper, 1 parts/equipment/containers, 5 coal, 1 logs, 1 molasses. 16 To discharge, 5 sugar, 2 rice, 5 citrus, 1 citrus,cars, 3 luggage. 2 To discharge/load containers, 1 to discharge/load cars. Oil terminal - 2 Vessels berthed of which 1 to load crude oil, 1 to load diesel oil, 4 tankers waiting in roads of which 1 to load diesel, 2 crude oil, 1 fuel oil. 12 Tankers due to load of which 11 crude oil, 1 diesel oil.

April 15 - NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - Five vessels operating of which 3 alumina, 1 cabotage, 1 steel, 1 alumina discharger awaiting berth. 13 Vessels due during the week of which 11 loaders (3 non-ferrous metals, 1 steel, 3 cabotage, 4 apatite). 2 Dischargers (1 alumina, 1 cabotage).

SLOVENIA, April 14 - Koper - Eight vessels berthed of which 2 containers loading/discharging, 1 general cargo loading sawn timber, 1 general cargo discharging fishmeal, 2 bulk carriers loading coal/quartzite, 1 bulk carrier discharging soya, 1 car carrier discharging cars. 18 Vessels due during next 2 days of which 6 containers to load/discharge, 1 car carrier to load cars, 4 general cargo to load sawn timber/paper/steel products, 1 livestock to load bulls, 2 bulk carriers to discharge bauxite/chrome ore, 1 bulk carrier to load coal, 1 ferry, 1 reefer to discharge bananas, 1 tanker to discharge fuel. No delays expected.

SPAIN, April 13 - Sagunto - 15 Vessels operating of which 3 ro-ro discharging/loading general cargo, 7 discharging steel products, 1 loading steel products, 1 discharging timber, 1 discharging bulk ammonia, 1 discharging/loading general cargo, 1 loading fertiliser. No vessels outside commercial wharf. No delays. Aviles - Three vessels in port of which 1 loading talc, 2 discharging (1 scrap, 1 steel coils). Gijon - Six vessels in port of which 3 loading (1 cement, 2 steel products), 3 discharging (1 iron ore, 1 petroleum products, 1 beet pulp). No delays/congestion. Pasajes - April 15 - 19 Vessels in port of which 4 discharging scrap, 1 each discharging steel, granite, petcoke, fertiliser, 2 discharging sawn timber/logs, 4 discharging coils 2 discharging/loading cars, 3 loading steel. No delays.

TURKEY, April 14 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 7 Operating of which 3 containers, 3 dry cargo, 1 ro/ro. No berthing delays. Galata - 8 Cargo/passenger vessels operating. Port congested. Ambarli - 14 Vessels operating, no berthing delays. April 15 - Mersin - Four vessels awaiting orders, 25 operating of which loading, 2 flour, 1 legumes, 1 fertiliser, 1 soda, 1 pumice stones, 1 glass, 2 cement, 1 general cargo, 1 sodium sulphate, 1 glass bottles. Discharging, 1 each bananas, general cargo, paper, bulk soyoil, potatoes. Loading/discharging, 4 vehicles, 2 containers/vehicles/general cargo, 2 container vessels. Free zone piers - 1 Vessel discharging rice. Seka - One discharging timber.

UKRAINE, April 14 - Mariupol - 11 Vessels loading at berth (map, metal products, sulphur, coal, sunflowerseeds, slag, slabs) 1 container vessel discharging at berth 1 reloading sunflowerseed to sea-going vessel. 5 Waiting at anchorage to load (sulphur, coal), 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge sunflowerseed, 1 awaiting orders after discharging, 2 vessels under repair/dry-dock. 12 Floating storehouses (fertiliser, sulphur). 25 Due, (metal products, coal, general cargo, containers, sunflowerseed, fluorspar. Kerch - Two vessels loading at berth (glass, metal products), 1 waiting at anchorage to load ore. 5 Vessels under repair/dry-dock, 1 vessel due for repairs.

Berdiansk - One vessel loading sunflower seeds at berth. Mariupol - Nine vessels operating of which 7 loading, 2 fertiliser, 1 pipes, 1 steel, 1 pig iron, 1 sunflower seeds, coal. 1 Discharging sunflowerseed, 1 loading/discharging containers. 5 Waiting in roads to load of which 2 sulphur, 3 coal. 25 Due of which 15 to load, 7 steel, 6 coal, 1 pig iron, 1 sulphur. 2 To discharge, 1 sunflowerseed, 1 fluorspar. 6 To discharge/load containers, 1 to discharge/load equipment/slabs, 1 cargo not nominated.

Odessa - April 15 - 22 Vessels operating of which 8 loading, 4 metal, 1 fertiliser, 1 sugar, 2 oil. 2 Discharging, 1 sugar, 1 gas oil. Passenger vessels, 3 waiting, 4 under repair, 7 waiting in roads of which 6 to load, 4 sunflowerseed, 1 steel, 1 peas, 1 to discharge containers. 8 Due of which 4 to load, 3 metal, 1 stee. 3 To discharge, 1 citrus, 2 containers, 1 passenger. Ilyichevsk - April 15 - Ten operating of which 7 to load, 6 steel, 1 pig iron 1 woodpulp vessel. 2 Vessels discharging containers, 1 vessel to discharge/load containers/woodpulp/other, 6 waiting in roads to load of which 1 pig iron, 1 container, 3 steel, 1 potash. Odessa - Steel cargo loading, 4 alongside, 1 anchored, 4 due. Containers, 1 anchored 2 due. Grain cargo loading, 6 vessels anchored. Tankers loading, 2 alongside. General cargo, 1 alongside, 1 due. Fertiliser, 1 alongside. Bulk sugar, 1 alongside. Ilyichevsk - Steel cargo loading, 7 alongside. Containers, 1 alongside. General cargo, 1 vessel alongside.

YUGOSLAVIA, April 15 - Bar - Five vessels berthed of which 1 discharging bananas, 2 loading steel coils, 1 loading acetic acid, 1 loading metal. Zelenika (Bijela) - One vessel discharging gasoline, 1 laid up, 2 under repairs.
